design: Use fixed pooled historical selection weights and private evaluation weights. Subtract each candidate cell own variance gain from its marginal objective to target gains on other cells. Select under each law or maximize worst per-law fractional marginal gain relative to the best candidate in that law at that step. Evaluate fixed sets under the three design laws and two interpolation laws excluded from the selection objective.
scope: Hypothetical direct measurements. Variance laws are sensitivity assumptions, not fitted to hidden OD errors.
